submitted.rationale: Every phase in Sb-Y-O has a wide band gap, so 2.1 eV light gives only a tiny response. XRD at indices 15, 23 and 28 showed the same fluorite-type pattern along the whole line, so it could not tell the compositions apart. Of the 3 merit measurements, index 7 (Sb 0.106) gave the highest EQE, 1.4e-3 %. That is about 16 times more than index 14 and above the noise-level readings.
